messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up 1 LumenBank kickoff. They're evaluating a swap from AltAI to Redwood. Main asks: prompt/response parity, token billing delta, function-calling JSON compatibility, and enterprise must-haves (SAML+SCIM, IP allowlist). Can we run a short POC next week?

david-solutions: Yes. We should get a few canonical request samples from them (chat + function call + streaming). Also need their current token billing unit so we can map costs.

anya-ml: ran a pilot yesterday comparing AltAI->Redwood on 10k chats. Observed ~+20% tokens on average because AltAI strips trailing whitespace and has a hidden system prompt. Also saw differences in stop-sequence behavior. I'll produce a short report with a token-delta histogram.

todd-eng: infra: hosted POC ok w/ anonymized data. If they require IP allowlist or VPC peering we need contract + DPA before provisioning Dedicated; lead time ~4 business days. For SSO we support SAML/SCIM; SCIM provisioning needs a bit of mapping for groups.

maria-sales: Lumen asked for a conservative cost delta for their 150M tokens/mo baseline. They want a figure to present to execs.

david-solutions: quick napkin: AltAI list ~$0.0009/token. With measured +20% tokens that's ~1.2x. But with batching + prefix caching we can likely drop effective tokens by 10-15% in production. I'll draft a 2-line slide: worst-case 1.2x, expected after optimizations ~0.95-1.05x.

liz-legal: security questionnaire attached. Top asks: BYOK, KMS separation, retention windows, SOC2 report, and an IP/contract clause for on-prem-like isolation. @todd-eng confirm BYOK options & SOC2 availability?

todd-eng: BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted supports customer-managed keys on request but no dedicated HSM unless Dedicated. SOC2 Type II available; I can attach the latest report and architecture diagram.

anya-ml: quick tech note on function calls: AltAI flattens nested JSON and escapes differently. Our function-calling returns a JSON AST under choices[].message.content. Recommend a small compatibility proxy to remap payloads and normalize JSON escaping. I'll share a test harness.

david-solutions: example shim (node/express) for them to run in staging:

```
// simple compat shim
app.post('/v1/altai/generate', async (req, res) => {
  const inBody = req.body;
  const mapped = mapAltAIToRedwood(inBody);
  const r = await redwood.generate(mapped);
  res.json(mapRedwoodToAltAI(r));
});
```

maria-sales: good. ask Lumen for 10-15 "problematic" prompts where they saw drift. also request sample function schemas they rely on.

anya-ml: I'll run a 1k prompt eval comparing exact-match + BERT-similarity and flag classes of mismatches (stop-truncation, numeric rounding, JSON-escape).

liz-legal: enterprise blocker: Lumen requires signed DPA before any network-level connections (allowlist/VPC). We can do a hosted eval without DPA if data is anonymized and retention set to 24h. Confirm?

todd-eng: correct. Hosted short eval ok under those constraints. Anything that needs persistent IP allowlist or KMS BYOK requires DPA & contract. Provisioning ETA still ~4 business days after contract.

ci-bot: CI: compatibility-poc-staging build started by david-solutions  tags: lumenbank, compat  estimated 18m

maria-sales: next steps: (1) ask Lumen for 15 sample payloads + token-metering sample, (2) anya to run token-diff + eval harness by Thu, (3) david to prepare cost delta slide + shim repo link by EOD Wed, (4) liz to send initial DPA template to Lumen legal. I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Fri 10am ET.

david-solutions: ack. I'll also include an optional recommendation: enable prefix KV caching and a 200ms batching window to cut effective token usage for chat-heavy flows.

anya-ml: starting token diffs now. will post a short CSV + top-10 prompt offenders.

liz-legal: I'll draft the DPA ask and request SOC2 and KMS diagrams from todd.

maria-sales: thanks all 1 keeping this thread as the single source for the LumenBank POC. :rocket:
